title: pteris aspericaulis var. subindivisa
intro: Pteris aspericaulis var. subindivisa, commonly known as the Indian brake fern, is a plant species belonging to the Pteris genus, characterized by its distinctive fronds and astringent properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Pteris aspericaulis var. subindivisa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit strong antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health, but its potential therapeutic applications make it an area of interest for future studies.
